title: Maine FFA Award Winners
before:
Each year, Maine FFA provides a number of awards to recognize superior accomplishments by students. Awards may take the form of plaques, ribbons, and/or cash. Most awards are based on events of the annual State FFA Convention held each spring. To learn how to apply for some of these awards and honors, visit the Forms & Resources web page.

Honorary Maine FFA Degree Recipients — 2026

Award presented to members of Maine's agriculture and natural resources community who have demonstrated a high level of commitment and service to the Maine FFA Association.

  • Mr. Lane McCrum, Maine FFA Alumni and Judge
  • Ms. Lisa Udasco, University of Maine 
  • Ms. Megan Cook, Maine FFA Alumni and Partner
  • Mr Gary Nadeau, Sponsor and Supporter 

Proficiency Award State Winners — 2026

Monetary and honorary awards based on student accomplishments outside of the classroom in an area related to agriculture and natural resources. Students compete in placement (work as an employee) or entrepreneurship (student-initiated activity). Winners receive $250 and proceed to the national level.

  • Callie C., Ashland High 
  • Carter C., Ashland High 
  • Caiden C., Ashland High
  • Jillian M., Lincoln Academy 
  • Madeline B., Presque Isle 
  • Peyton M., Presque Isle 
  • Rachel M., Presque Isle 
  • Lane C., Caribou 

Maine FFA Chapter Advisor of the Year — 2025-2026

Award presented to a stellar chapter FFA advisor upon nomination by the home chapter and selection by the state FFA officer review committee.

  • Golden Owl Finalists: Brittany Hemond, Poland FFA and Teri Driscoll of Ashland Middle School FFA
  • Advisor of the Year: Kevin Marquis, Easton FFA 

Maine FFA Outstanding Chapter Officer — 2026

Award presented for superior service to a Maine FFA student chapter officer, following nomination by the home FFA chapter advisor and selection by the state FFA officer review committee.

  • Finalists: Madison B. of Presque Isle and Carter C. of Ashland FFA
  • Outstanding Member: Hiram B., of Tri-County Technical Center 

State FFA Degree Recipients — 2026

Recognition presented annually to student FFA members who have demonstrated exemplary commitment to and accomplishments in the Maine FFA Association and who have completed the required application.

  • Helen R. of Lincoln Academy
  • Aubrie P. of Mars Hill
  • Courtney D. of Presque Isle
  • Cassidy R. of Caribou
  • Wyatt M.H. of Easton
  • Allison B. of Easton
  • Madison B., of Presque Isle 

State Stars — 2026

Award based on superior accomplishments by students with advanced outside-of-the-classroom activities related to agriculture and natural resources. State winners receive $300 and proceed to national competition.

  • Carter C., Ag Placement, Ashland HS

 Scholarships — 2026

Award based on superior accomplishments by students interested in pursuing post-secondary education in agriculture or a related field. State winners receive $1,000.

  • Guerrette Scholarship- Callie C., Ashland High School
  • Bowen Scholarship- Jack M., of Easton 

Washington Leadership Conference Scholarship Award — 2026

This award covers the registration cost of $950 per member for a high-quality, one-week leadership training conducted in the summer by the National FFA Organization. Presented to students who complete thorough applications and show promise at the chapter and state level.  

  • Peyton H. and Jamie M. of Easton
  • Sierra H. of Poland
  • Rebecca S. and Jillian G. of Mars Hill
